description: Re-run ONLY the AI narration step against an existing completed forecast run. Costs 1-2 AI credits (no engine work). Returns the new narration; the old one is overwritten in the run record. Refuses when the run is not yet complete or when narration_enabled=false on the forecast.

run_id.description: UUID of a COMPLETED run. Use get_forecast_run with run_id='latest' first if you want the most recent.

name: regenerate_forecast_narrative

narration.description: Narration payload (summary, highlights, risks, recommendations, methodology_note, credits_consumed, model_used, generated_at, fallback_reason). fallback_reason is null on success; one of 'insufficient_credits', 'llm_failed', 'disabled', 'org_disabled' when narration was skipped.
